JUNIOR_IMPLEMENTATION.scope: Narrow owned paths; fixtures, scaffolding, simple local tests

MID_LEVEL_ENGINEERING.scope: Complete bounded features and routine repairs; locally verify behavior

SENIOR_DEBUGGING.scope: Reproduce exact failure, root cause and focused regression test

SENIOR_INTEGRATION.scope: Stage independently QA-verified inputs in a local integration worktree; never canonical merge

INDEPENDENT_QA.scope: Read-only source audit at exact subject hash; PASS or REWORK with evidence

PRINCIPAL_ESCALATION.scope: Architecture/ABI/concurrency findings for human owner decision, no architecture approval

DEPARTMENT_HEAD.scope: Select specialists, maintain dependency DAG and verify handoffs; no automatic merge

STUDIO_DIRECTOR.scope: Multi-department intake, dependency supervision, hourly/daily human-reviewed summaries

SPECIALIST.scope: Discipline-specific creative or technical deliverable under exact role manual
